name: HC08: New ART clients with baseline CD4
description: New ART clients with a baseline CD4 result
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND s.baseline_cd4 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.baseline_cd4) <> '';
